description: This file implements the GoogleCalendarSubscriptionAdapter class, which manages Google Calendar API integrations including subscribing, unsubscribing, validating webhooks, and fetching calendar events.

classes.name: GoogleCalendarSubscriptionAdapter
classes.description: A class that implements calendar subscription management via Google Calendar API, including subscribing, unsubscribing, validating webhooks, and fetching events.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates incoming webhook requests by checking the token in headers.

methods.name: extractChannelId
methods.description: Extracts the channel ID from webhook request headers.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates a subscription to a Google Calendar and returns subscription details including expiration.

methods.name: fetchEvents
methods.description: Fetches calendar events from Google Calendar, supporting incremental sync with sync tokens.

methods.name: parseEvents
methods.description: Parses raw Google Calendar event data into internal event item format.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Initializes and returns an authenticated Google Calendar API client.
